profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Base Power
profile.summary:
I currently serve as a Platform Development Engineering Manager at Cirrus Logic, where I manage a software development team of seven engineers. My work focuses on creating innovative internal tools that enhance semiconductor workflows, including instrument control, test frameworks, database integration, DevOps automation, and a data analytics platform. I lead an Agile software process in collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions.

Previously, I contributed to the design, deployment, and maintenance of high-energy laser facility control systems at National Energetics and supported semiconductor test systems at National Instruments. My expertise lies in Agile methodologies for software engineering in a diverse set of complex applications. My professional mission is to streamline complex systems and enable technological advancements across industries.

positions.description: Skills: Software Infrastructure · Engineering

positions.title: Platfrom Development Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Manage software development team of seven engineers, driving the development of innovative internal tools that support semiconductor workflows. Solutions span instrument control, test framework, project templating, test execution, software asset management, custom hardware drivers, asset tracking, database integration, report generation, analytics dashboards, integrating with design verification simulation, and schematic parsing. 
Run Agile Software process with cross functional stakeholders.

positions.title: Validation Tools Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Bitbucket · Docker · Git · SQL · Jenkins · React.js · DevOps · Jira · Confluence · Web Application Development · REST APIs · Full-Stack Development · GitHub · JavaScript · pytest · Test Automation Frameworks

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tech Lead and Architect for all software and control electronics of high energy laser facilities. 
Design, deploy, and support embedded motor control systems, distributed vision network, vacuum control systems, coolant systems with LabVIEW and National Instruments hardware.
Design and manage build for control electronics and electrical cabinets.
Manage team of contractors, gather and negotiate requirements using Agile project management principles.
Design & build networked lab systems.
Build on-premise DevOps systems including custom Jenkins server for LabVIEW, manage software deployments, administer Perforce SCC, drive initiatives to improve scientific data storage management for scientists.
positions.insights: Skills: Jenkins · DevOps · Test Automation Frameworks

positions.title: Automated Test System Engineer
positions.description: Provide technical expertise and reduce technical risk for business to business sales contracts. Activities include ATE System Design Consultation, Technical Evaluation and Requirements Analysis, Prototyping PXI Systems, Software Development and Support, On-Site Deployment. Special emphasis on Semiconductor Test.

positions.title: Applications Engineer
positions.description: Provide technical customer support and training on measurement systems. Deliver customer assistance turning PXI products into custom solutions. Lead on-site training and support. Develop reference applications for customer reuse.

positions.title: National Science Fellow: Building Bridges
positions.description: This program prepares forty (eight per year) experienced doctoral-level science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM) graduate students and forty (eight per year) secondary STEM teachers to work in an interdisciplinary environment by developing novel Mathematics, Engineering, and Science Bridge Quartets (MESBQ), where a GK-12 Science or Engineering Fellow and a GK-12 Mathematics Fellow will partner with corresponding in-service science and mathematics teachers. http://www.depts.ttu.edu/GK12/General.php

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: Draft technical CAD documents in AutoCAD for industrial automation systems.

positions.title: GEAR Coordinator
positions.description: Getting Excited About Robotics (GEAR, http://www.gearrobotics.org) is a competition for elementary and middle school students to use LEGO Mindstorm kits to build robots to navigate obstacles and solve simple problems like flicking a light switch or transporting a tennis ball. This year (2008) hosted 14 schools with 400+ competitors. My position was head coordinator, managing teams to construct fields and game pieces, organize mentors to visit schools, and manage the event.

positions.title: B.E.S.T. Technical Assistant
positions.description: Perform testing on developing PCB hardware for rapid robotics prototyping in high school competitions. Build robot projects to identify potential failures and analyze performance. Provide support for robot hardware in high school competitions.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Test communications algorithms for increasing bandwidth capabilities.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Develop and characterize new acoustic cancellation algorithms.
